scope: Original successful reference plus completed explicitly listed v3 diagnostic groups; no model ranking or score mutations.

definitions.preclosure_reach: Last 15Hz pad-midpoint-to-packet OBB distance before frozen absolute closure>=.25 event; metric is geometric proxy, not fingertip clearance.
definitions.stage: Nearest 15Hz sample to original frozen score event, up to .034s from event; sustained stage gates unchanged.
definitions.stop: Exact 125Hz execution first safety stop; object evidence nearest 15Hz sample can fall just after stop.
definitions.played_opening: Delivered gripper ZOH row at recorded play_time, original-policy eligibility from historical terminal-veto diagnostics; stopped rows excluded. Raw proposal tails counted separately.
definitions.nearest_y: Original carry-to-release trajectory nearest measured transport Y; progress diagnostic, not full state matching or counterfactual.
definitions.limits: Rendering and inference timing differ. No controlled causal attribution from cross-run deltas; sensor/force magnitudes and geometry remain simulation hypotheses.

additional_closure_diagnostic.definition: Last sampled pad-midpoint distance to the object OBB before the first additional closing command; diagnostic only, no change to frozen full-task gates.
